label: SYNTHETIC-DERIVED: the lowest and highest id of every Alpha-5 letter, rendered from one real CelesTrak record with the catalog number replaced; not served by any provider
description: All 24 Alpha-5 letters at both ends of their ranges (X0000 and X9999), less the two ids real records hold (100000, 270000): specification vectors as readable TLE sets
statement: synthetic-derived (D-096, D-125, D-286, D-300): SARAMAGO's first-record elements with the catalog number replaced; each id is a specification vector, not a catalogued object. D-016 stands: real records are the only source of real-id sets, and this file poses as no catalog data.
renderer_validation: tools/validate_render.py: 304/304 CelesTrak TLE records reproduced exactly (lines 0, 1, 2) with these settings on 2026-09-21
catalog_field_encoding: Alpha-5 (Space-Track table: A=10 ... Z=33, I and O skipped)
known_differences_from_a_celestrak_tle: the catalog numbers are specification vectors (X0000 and X9999 per letter), not catalogued objects
columns 3-7 of lines 1 and 2 hold an Alpha-5 code instead of five digits
the checksum is computed over the Alpha-5 line (letters count 0, minus signs count 1)
